cases.description: When getSchema is called with a null JsonNode the method should throw a NullPointerException because the underlying newJsonSchema implementation expects a non‑null schema node.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) with no validation errors
cases.description: An empty JSON object represents an empty schema. The factory should return a valid JsonSchema object (not null) that can be used for validation without throwing any exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose getSchemaNode() equals the supplied node
cases.description: A minimal valid JSON‑Schema (type string) should be accepted and wrapped in a JsonSchema object. The returned schema should contain the same node that was supplied.

group: Schema Node with $schema Keyword (different meta‑schema versions)

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) that uses Draft‑07 meta‑schema internally
cases.description: When the supplied node contains a $schema keyword the factory must detect the version (draft‑07) and create a JsonSchema that validates against that meta‑schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) that uses Draft‑04 meta‑schema internally
cases.description: Same as above but for draft‑04. This verifies that the internal version‑selection branch is exercised.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaValidationException (or any RuntimeException thrown by newJsonSchema)
cases.description: A schema where the 'type' keyword has an illegal value should cause the factory to reject the schema and throw an exception during schema creation.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) that treats the array as the root schema node
cases.description: The factory should accept any JsonNode, not only objects. Passing an array verifies the branch that handles non‑object root nodes.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose getSchemaNode() is a BooleanNode with value true
cases.description: A JSON‑Schema can be the boolean literal true, meaning any instance is valid. The factory must accept a BooleanNode and return a JsonSchema wrapper without throwing.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose getSchemaNode() is a BooleanNode with value false
cases.description: A JSON‑Schema can be the boolean literal false, meaning no instance is valid. The factory must accept a BooleanNode and produce a JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaValidationException (or any RuntimeException) because a numeric node is not a valid schema root
cases.description: Passing a numeric JsonNode as the schema root should be rejected during schema creation, resulting in an exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaValidationException (or any RuntimeException) because a text node is not a valid schema root
cases.description: A plain string node cannot represent a JSON‑Schema; the factory should throw an exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) that falls back to the factory's default meta‑schema version
cases.description: When the $schema keyword points to an unknown or unsupported meta‑schema, the factory should not fail but should use the default version (e.g., Draft‑2020‑12) to create the schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) that correctly normalises the URI and uses Draft‑07 meta‑schema
cases.description: The factory should trim whitespace and handle trailing fragments when resolving the $schema URI.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) where internal resolution of $ref succeeds (no exception during creation)
cases.description: A schema that defines an $id and uses a relative $ref should be parsed successfully; the factory must resolve the reference during schema construction.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) – creation succeeds; external resolution is deferred to validation time
cases.description: When the root schema contains only an external $ref, getSchema should still create a JsonSchema object without trying to fetch the external document at construction.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose getSchemaNode() equals the supplied complex node
cases.description: A realistic, multi‑level schema should be accepted; the factory must correctly preserve the whole node hierarchy.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) that resolves the URN to Draft‑07 meta‑schema
cases.description: The factory supports URN‑based meta‑schema identifiers; this test verifies that a URN $schema is correctly translated to the appropriate version.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) where the last occurrence of the keyword wins (type = "string")
cases.description: When a schema node contains duplicate keywords, Jackson retains the last one. The factory should not fail and should use the resulting node.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or RuntimeException) caused by URISyntaxException because the $schema value is not a valid URI
cases.description: The $schema keyword contains a syntactically invalid URI; the factory should attempt to parse it and fail, propagating an exception.
